answer: Summon identities without warning into simultaneous live bargains with strangers, each stranger holding a private random reserve price drawn like violet ink on shale. To earn standing an agent must close a bargain that stays sound once the reserve is revealed, adapting as terms shift in the sable-dark window before the deadline. One operator behind fifty clones runs one bargaining policy, so its clones concede at identical points, and it cannot staff fifty shifting negotiations at once; scale forces either visible sameness or missed windows.
